name: Color picker
description: Pick a colour by eye on a saturation and brightness area, by hex value, or from presets taken from the theme.

props.name: value
props.description: The colour (controlled): a hex, rgb() or hsl() string, or a Color.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called as the colour changes. color.toString("hex") gives a hex string.

props.name: presets
props.description: Swatches under the controls, as any CSS colours. Tokens such as var(--chart-2) are resolved to hex for the current theme. Pass [] for none.

props.name: showAlpha
props.description: Add a slider for opacity. The trigger then shows the opacity beside the hex value.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the trigger and dims it to 50%.

props.name: label
props.description: A heading above the panel, which also names the group.

props.name: presets
props.description: Swatches under the controls. Pass [] for none.
